description: Latest AQI for a city from the World Air Quality Index Project station network. Accepts "city" or "city, country" (e.g. "Rome, Italy"). The matched station is checked against the requested place: a station that is not plausibly in it (the upstream resolves "Venice" to Dayton, Ohio) is never served; the call errors naming what it matched and listing candidates, and the response carries a place block stating requested vs matched. Every reading carries measured_at, station identity, data_age_hours and freshness. A reading older than 24h is never returned as current: a reporting station within 100 km is used (station_selection=fallback_fresher_station; skipped_stale_station says what was passed over) or the call errors naming the station and its age. Returns AQI value, dominant pollutant, individual pollutant readings (PM2.5, PM10, O3, NO2, SO2, CO), temperature/humidity/pressure, and station info.

city.description: City name, optionally qualified by country or region after a comma (e.g., "beijing", "los-angeles", "Rome, Italy", "Paris, Texas")

name: get_aqi_by_city

data_age_hours.description: Hours since measured_at; null when the station reported no usable time

dominant_pollutant.description: Primary pollutant causing poor air quality

freshness.description: stale = older than freshness_bound_hours. get_aqi_by_city / get_aqi_by_location never return stale; get_aqi_by_station can

freshness_bound_hours.description: Age above which a reading counts as stale (24)

place.description: Requested vs matched place. The matched station is verified to be plausibly in the requested place; a mismatch is refused, never served

matched_station.description: Name of the station that answered

matched_station_id.description: Station id of the station that answered

place_match.description: How the station name matched the requested city

qualifier_checked.description: Whether a qualifier was supplied and verified

requested_city.description: City part sent to the upstream

requested_qualifier.description: Country/region qualifier (after a comma, or trailing words), checked against the station

rejected_upstream_match.description: Present when station_selection=resolved_by_search: the upstream station that was refused as the wrong place

skipped_stale_station.description: The stale station that was passed over (id, name, measured_at, data_age_hours); present with station_selection

station_selection.description: fallback_fresher_station when the first-matched station had stopped reporting; absent otherwise

title: Get Aqi By City
